Reasoning vs rest is a group-level whole-brain task-evoked contrast of relational reasoning (problem solving). It meets GLOBAL inclusion criteria and thus qualifies as the domain-general problem-solving map.
Stimuli are not numerical and no arithmetic manipulation is involved; does not meet MATHEMATICAL_PROBLEM_SOLVING_I1.
Problems are presented as sentences (auditory) and involve deductive relational reasoning over verbal material, satisfying VERBAL_PROBLEM_SOLVING_I1 in addition to global criteria.
Although the content is spatial, the problems are presented verbally (sentences). Domain is decided by stimulus modality, so VISUOSPATIAL_PROBLEM_SOLVING_I1 is not met.
This contrast does not manipulate problem difficulty or demand parametrically (no harder>easier manipulation), so it does not meet LOGICAL_REASONING_I1.

Maintenance vs rest is a group-level whole-brain task contrast (task > rest) with participants performing an evaluative memory/comparison task; it meets the global whole-brain task criteria and is included in the pooled domain-general set.
No numerical stimuli or arithmetic manipulation are present; does not meet MATHEMATICAL_PROBLEM_SOLVING_I1.

The contrast does not vary problem demand or difficulty parametrically (no harder>easier manipulation), so LOGICAL_REASONING_I1 is not met.

Conjunction (reasoning AND maintenance) vs rest identifies common task-evoked activations across the two problem conditions at the group whole-brain level, satisfying global criteria and qualifying for the pooled domain-general label.

Both constituent tasks are presented as auditory sentences and involve judgements over verbal material; the conjunction therefore meets VERBAL_PROBLEM_SOLVING_I1 in addition to globals.

This conjunction does not represent a demand/difficulty manipulation (no parametric harder>easier contrast), so LOGICAL_REASONING_I1 is not met.

The contrast is a difficulty/complexity comparison (RC level 3 > RC level 1), matching permitted contrast types (GLOBAL_I3). Assign logical_reasoning in addition to the representational domain.
